video_title: Among Us but we CHOOSE our Roles!
evidence: PWR's July 19, 2026 English-language YouTube video publicly lists Nacon as its official controller partner and links the Nacon Revolution 5 Pro. PWR's own official partners page describes an ongoing two-year multi-platform partnership with Nacon and RIG, including Nacon controller promotion across creator content and retail. SponsorRadar tracks 73 Nacon YouTube sponsorships across 23 creators and includes roster-relevant creators such as Ruba (~131K) and GamersPrey (~244K), confirming creator spend below mega-channel scale as well. Nacon sells tangible gaming controllers and peripherals. Nacon's official accessories partnership support page, updated in 2026, explicitly invites content creators, influencers and streamers to contact creators-accessories@nacon.fr for product-review partnerships.
signals: Creator spend includes sub-250K gaming channels
